# front-not-end

> front-not-end is an Apache-2.0 Agent Skill for Codex that helps frontend developers turn product requests into production-capable backend changes while preserving the target repository's existing contracts and conventions.

Use this project when a frontend or product request creates or changes APIs, server-side data, authentication, permissions, persistence, background jobs, integrations, deployment, or other production backend behavior. The user owns product intent and authorization for irreversible or external actions; the Coding Agent owns backend technical completeness.

Status: experimental 0.x. Current evidence covers three runnable Codex tracers: scoped List/Search, authorized idempotent creation, and signed retry-safe order webhooks. It does not establish broad stack/Host coverage, durable database behavior, or external notification-delivery guarantees.

## Start here

- [Install and usage](https://github.com/xllily/front-not-end/blob/master/README.md): Human-readable overview, installation, example prompt, and runnable tracer instructions.
- [Canonical Agent Skill](https://github.com/xllily/front-not-end/blob/master/skills/front-not-end/SKILL.md): Authoritative instructions that an Agent must follow. Prefer this file over summaries elsewhere.
- [Product contract](https://github.com/xllily/front-not-end/blob/master/docs/product-contract.md): Current product promise, ownership boundary, and non-goals.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/xllily/front-not-end/blob/master/docs/architecture.md): How the installable Skill, target repository, and verification evidence relate.

- [Continuous integration and releases](https://github.com/xllily/front-not-end/blob/master/docs/automation.md): Automated checks and release behavior.
